dedupe_keys.name: ndrp storm tide hazard interpolation series

description: NDRP Storm Tide Hazard Interpolation series is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. Water level rasters (m AHD), depth rasters (m) and flood extent polygons for the Queensland coast have been estimated based on point data from the NDRP Storm Tide Hazard Interpolation Study (GHD, 2014). These layers have been developed through GHD's proprietary GIS toolset that acts to extrapolate point data to a provided DEM. See: qld. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. It offers 4 resource(s) in spatial data format, xml. The portal shows 2020-11-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
